versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated default model in SKILL.md from u1-insuremed to u2-med.
- No functional changes to the skill logic.

- Initial release of med-emr-qc-pmh-missing-bp-glucose skill for outpatient record quality control.
- Checks for documentation of "hypertension/blood pressure and blood glucose control" status in past medical history based on input medical records.
- Returns either "无缺陷" (no defect) or "有缺陷" (with reason).
- Supports input as plain text and batch files (pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, csv, txt, json).
- Emphasizes data privacy: no local storage, strictly de-identified input, and compliance with minimal necessary principle.
- All QC and LLM logic self-contained; requires only standard Python libraries (with optional openpyxl/pypdf for multi-format input).
